versions.changelog:
- Initial release of evidence-enhanced academic paper analysis workflow.
- Supports structured extraction of key paper elements (title, task, background, methods, datasets, results, etc.) with direct evidence citations.
- Carries out consistency verification to assess extraction accuracy and hallucination risk.
- Generates detailed, editable reports in Markdown, HTML, and DOCX formats.
- Handles both local file uploads and direct paper URLs; supports output in Chinese or English.
- All input and output files are organized and saved under the Ubuntu desktop for easy access.
